text: importToFFI checks the JSON key inventory even when the native import returned zero. Missing or empty info.keys changes the return to -1. Higher callers also inspect importedKeys.length. In this key-import scope, success needs useful imported material as well as a native success status; this does not mean every application API treats empty results as failure.
